description.value: A pillar of raw magical energy explodes at the center of the area of effect pulsing out in a 30-ft.-radius burst for 1d6 points of non-elemental damage per caster level (maximum of 20d6). The victims continue being battered by raw magical energy for 2d6 points of non-elemental damage per round. A successful Fortitude save reduces the damage by half and negates the raw magical energy. If the target fails the initial saving throw, it gets another chance to save every round until the duration is ended.
